items.title: 11.4 Dil aur naliyon ke amraz (cardiovascular disorders) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.4, printed pages 246-249.

blocks.text: Cardiovascular disorders (dil aur khoon ki naliyon ki bimariyan) taraqqi yafta (developed) aur taraqqi pazeer (developing) dono qism ke mulkon mein maut ki sab se bari wajah hain. In mein khoon ki naliyon aur dil ki kharabiyan shamil hain. In bimariyon ki bari wajah do halatein hain: atherosclerosis aur arteriosclerosis.

Atherosclerosis ka matlab hai “arteries ke andar cheezon ka jam jana”. Arteries mein kai cheezein jama ho sakti hain, maslan charbi wale maddey (fatty materials), smooth muscle cells ki ghair-mamooli miqdar, cholesterol, fibrin aur mukhtalif qism ka cells ka malba (debris). Yeh sab jamao arteries ko theek kaam nahin karne dete. Cholesterol ka jama hona atherosclerosis ki sab se bari wajah samjha jata hai. Atherosclerosis heart attack ka sabab ban sakti hai, kyun ke is se arteries tang ho jati hain aur thrombus (khoon ka lothra) banne ka khatra barh jata hai.

Arteriosclerosis ka matlab hai “arteries ki deewaron ka sakht ho jana”. Yeh tab hoti hai jab arteries ki deewaron mein calcium jama ho jaye. Aisi arteries mein khoon ka bahao kam ho jata hai aur arteries normal tareeqe se phail nahin saktin. Is wajah se dil ko zyada mehnat karni parti hai. Shadeed (severe) atherosclerosis aam taur par arteriosclerosis ki taraf le jati hai.

Dil ke mareezon ka asal masla dhoondne aur bimari kitni shadeed hai yeh naapne ke liye kai tashkhees (diagnosis) ke tests kiye jate hain. Ahem tests ECG aur angiography hain. ECG ki readings aap parh chuke hain; yahan angiography ki bunyadi baatein dekhte hain.
Angiography

Coronary angiography dil ki khoon ki naliyon ya dil ke khanon ka X-ray muaina (examination) hai. X-ray tasweerein banane ke liye doctor ek patli nali jaisa aala, jise catheter kehte hain, jism ki bari arteries ke andar se aage barhata hai. Jab catheter ka sira coronary arteries ke munh tak pohanchta hai to catheter mein ek khaas mayah (contrast medium ya dye) daala jata hai. Yeh mayah X-ray machine mein nazar aata hai. Coronary artery mein is mayah ki tasweerein (angiograms) li jati hain. Agar coronary artery ke lumen (andar ki khali jagah) mein lothre (clots) hon to artery tang nazar aati hai.

Diagnostic catheter (muaine wala catheter) ko guiding catheter (rasta dikhane wala catheter) se badal kar doctor catheter ke andar se coronary artery mein koi aala bhi daal sakte hain. Sab se zyada istemal hone wale aale guide wires aur balloon dilation catheters (ghubbara laga catheter) hain (angioplasty dekhein).
Thrombosis

Thrombus banne ke amal ko thrombosis kehte hain. Thrombus khoon ki nali ke andar khoon ke ajza ka ek thos lothra ya daat (clot) hai. Yeh lothra nali ko poora ya kuch hissa band kar sakta hai. Thrombus banne ki wajahen yeh ho sakti hain: (i) khoon ki nali ki andar ki parat mein jalan (irritation) ya infection, (ii) bohat der tak harkat na karne se khoon ke bahao ki raftar kam ho jana, ya (iii) pneumonia, tuberculosis, emphysema waghaira.

blocks.title: Thromboembolism
blocks.text: Khoon ki nali mein thrombus ka banna aur phir us ka kisi aur jagah beh kar chale jana thromboembolism kehlata hai.

Thrombosis aza (organs) tak khoon ka bahao rok deti hai. Coronary arteries mein thrombosis heart attack ka sabab banti hai. Isi tarah dimagh ki naliyon mein thrombus stroke (falij) ka sabab banta hai. Thrombus apni jagah se ukhar kar circulatory system mein kisi aur jagah ja sakta hai. Aise behte hue thrombus ko embolus kehte hain.
Dil ke masail aur ilaj (Heart Problems and Treatments)

Hum jante hain ke coronary arteries dil ke muscles ko oxygen aur nutrients deti hain. Agar coronary arteries mein khoon ka bahao ruk jaye to dil ke muscle ke ek ya zyada hisson ko khoon poora nahin milta. Agar oxygen aur nutrients na milne se dil ke muscles mar jayen to is halat ko myocardial infarction (heart attack) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Taraqqi yafta mulkon mein dil ki bimari aur coronary artery ki bimari maut ki sab se bari wajahen hain.

Coronary arteries aam taur par is liye band hoti hain ke un ki andar ki deewar mein aahista aahista lipids (charbi), khaas kar cholesterol, jama hote rehte hain. Agar yeh halat jari rahe to pareshani (stress) ya jismani mehnat ke waqt seene mein dard ho sakta hai, jise angina pectoris kehte hain. Angina ka matlab hai ke dil ko jitni oxygen chahiye us se kam pohanch rahi hai, aur aage chal kar heart attack ho sakta hai.

Agar tarz-e-zindagi (lifestyle) badalne aur dawaon se alamaat (symptoms) theek na hon, ya tang coronary arteries ki wajah se heart attack ka foran khatra ho, to coronary bypass surgery ya angioplasty ki jati hai.

blocks.title: Heart attack ke baad
blocks.text: Heart attack ke baad sehat yabi mumkin hai agar dil ka kharab hissa itna chhota ho ke dil ki doosri khoon ki naliyan phail kar (apni capacity barha kar) kharab tissues ko dobara khoon pohancha sakein.
Coronary bypass surgery

Yeh dil ke muscles tak khoon ki rukawat ka hal nikalne ka sab se aam aur kamyab tareeqa hai. Is surgery mein surgeon mareez ki taang, bazu, seene ya pait se ek sehatmand khoon ki nali leta hai. Woh is nali ke dono sire band coronary artery ki rukawat se oopar aur neeche jor deta hai. Is tarah khoon kharab ya band hisse ke gird se (bypass ho kar) guzar jata hai.

blocks.title: Beating-heart surgery
blocks.text: Open ya beating-heart surgery us waqt ki jati hai jab dil dharak raha hota hai.

Coronary bypass surgery asal bimari, yani atherosclerosis ya coronary artery disease, ko khatam nahin karti. Kamyab bypass surgery ke baad bhi aainda rukawaton aur heart attack ka khatra kam karne ke liye tarz-e-zindagi badalna, khaas kar smoking chhorna, bohat zaroori hai. Is ke ilawa mareez ko khurak mein kuch qism ki charbi kam karni, jismani sargarmi barhani, aur high blood pressure, diabetes aur dil ki bimari ke doosre khatron (risk factors) ko control karna hota hai.

blocks.alt: Dil jis ke saamne coronary artery neeche jati hai aur ek graft nali aorta se artery ke ek box wale hisse ke neeche tak jori gai hai. Box bara kar ke: coronary artery peeli jamawat (deposit) se band hai, aur narangi bypass graft artery se rukawat ke oopar aur neeche jura hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khoon rukawat wali jagah ko chhor kar graft ke raste aage chala jata hai, is liye dil ka woh hissa phir se khoon pata hai.
Angioplasty aur stenting

Angioplasty aisa tareeqa hai jis se band ya tang artery kholi jati hai. Angioplasty mein X-ray ki madad se dekhte hue ek patli taar (kitab ise catheter kehti hai) tang coronary artery mein se guzari jati hai. Phir ek chhota, sausage jaisa ghubbara (balloon) is taar ke oopar se tang hisse tak pohanchaya jata hai. Phir balloon phulaya jata hai taake artery ka tang hissa chaura ho jaye. Artery chauri ho jaye to thora sa dye daal kar tasdeeq ki jati hai ke artery kamyabi se khul gai hai.

Angioplasty ke dauran stenting bhi ki ja sakti hai. Stent stainless steel ki jaali (mesh) ki ek nali hai jo phail sakti hai aur balloon catheter par chadhi hoti hai. Jab stent aur balloon tang artery ke andar sahi jagah pohanch jayen to balloon phulaya jata hai. Phoola hua balloon stent aur artery dono ko phaila deta hai. Phir balloon nikal liya jata hai aur stent wahin reh jata hai. Stent artery ki deewaron ko sahara deta hai aur artery ko khula aur chaura rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Tang artery ke teen number-shuda manzar. 1: catheter ek pichka hua balloon aur us par stent artery mein le jata hai, jahan plaque lumen ko tang karta hai. 2: balloon phulaya gaya, stent phail gaya aur plaque deewar se dab gaya. 3: balloon nikal liya gaya aur stent wahin reh kar artery ko khula rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Hypertension

Blood pressure ka lambe arse tak (chronic) barha rehna hypertension kehlata hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab blood pressure musalsal 140/90 se oopar rahe. Blood pressure ko control karne wale nervous ya hormonal nizam mein koi bhi kharabi hypertension ka sabab ban sakti hai. Doosri wajahen pareshani (stress), motapa (obesity), namak zyada khana aur smoking hain. Hypertension ki wajah mauroosi (hereditary, khandani) bhi ho sakti hai.

Jab blood pressure lambe arse tak zyada rahe to khoon ki naliyan phatne ka khatra barh jata hai. Agar aisa dimagh mein ho to ise brain haemorrhage (dimagh mein khoon behna) kehte hain. Is se dimagh ki nazuk banawat ko nuqsan pohanchta hai. Hypertension dil ke muscles ko bhi kamzor karta hai. Agar hypertension der tak rahe to dil theek se pump nahin kar pata aur tissues ki zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon nahin pohancha pata. Aisi halat mein khoon dil aur phephron mein ruk sakta hai. Isay congestive heart failure kehte hain. Hypertension gurdon ke nephrons ko bhi nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Is se khoon mein namak aur pani aur zyada rukte hain aur hypertension mazeed barh jata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Congestive heart failure mein seene ka dard, angina samet, nahin hota.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ko seerhiyan charhne par angina hoti hai, aur angiogram ek coronary artery cholesterol se tang dikhata hai. Muqabla karein ke stent ke saath angioplasty aur bypass surgery har ek kya karegi, aur batayein ke dono kya ilaj nahin kartin.
blocks.explanation: Angioplasty catheter ko tang hisse mein pohnchati hai, use phailane ko balloon phulati hai, aur artery khuli rakhne ko phailaya hua stainless steel stent chhor deti hai. Bypass surgery taang, bazu, seene ya pait se sehatmand nali le kar use rukawat ke oopar aur neeche jorti hai taake khoon us ke gird se guzre. Dono us atherosclerosis ka ilaj nahin kartin jis ne tangi ki, is liye mareez ko nai rukawaton se bachne ke liye smoking chhorni, charbi kam karni, warzish karni aur khoon ka dabao aur diabetes qaboo karne honge.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Atherosclerosis = arteries mein charbi, cholesterol, fibrin, muscle cells aur malbe ka jamao; arteries tang hoti hain aur thrombus ka khatra barhta hai. Arteriosclerosis = calcium se arteries ki deewar sakht.
Angiography: catheter se coronary arteries mein dye daal kar X-ray tasweerein (angiograms); lothra ho to artery tang dikhti hai.
Thrombus = nali mein lothra; ukhar kar behe to embolus. Coronary arteries mein heart attack, dimagh mein stroke.

Angina pectoris = oxygen kam pohanchne se seene ka dard, heart attack ki warning. Myocardial infarction = dil ke muscles ka marna. Ilaj: coronary bypass (nayi nali se rukawat ke gird rasta), angioplasty (balloon) aur stenting; saath tarz-e-zindagi badalna.
Hypertension = musalsal 140/90 se zyada; nateeje: brain haemorrhage, congestive heart failure, gurdon ko nuqsan.
